description: Returns available filing type options for use in injury record forms. Each option contains a label for display and a value to submit when creating or updating injuries. Values are ordered from least to highest severity.

label.description: Human-readable display name for the filing type (e.g. 'First Aid'). Use in UI dropdowns and form labels.

value.description: Server-side value to submit when creating or updating an injury record's filing type (e.g. 'first_aid').
